utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, I’m on the repair drive — I’ll check what’s still needed and send over the details soon. If I miss anything, feel free to give me a quick reminder.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Noah — I’ll keep track of the location and time, and I’ll watch for your details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks — I’ll send the repair drive details over soon and keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ve got a basic toolbox, a drill, and a ladder, and I’m free this afternoon after 3.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll spread the word that you’ve got tools and are free after 3 this afternoon. That’ll help get more neighbors out for the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks Quinn — let me know the next step and I’ll be ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll keep it flexible and start with the bikes and tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — I’ll pass along the final timing as soon as I hear it, and bikes and tools sounds like a great start.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks Tess — just send the timing when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’m out running errands later, so I’ll ask around and bring back whatever I hear.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Ira — that would be a big help. If you hear of anyone who can take the porch railing, the leaky faucet, or bring a drill, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You got it — I’ll keep an eye out for anyone handy and let you know what I hear while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m still a little foggy on the details, but I can ask around and bring you the latest in a few minutes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren — that would help. Please tell me what repairs they’re collecting for and if anything specific is needed right now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ll check what repairs they’re prioritizing and whether they need tools, parts, or extra hands right now. I’m a bit foggy, but I’ll bring back the details as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Kira — I’m still piecing together the latest, so I’d love any update you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, that’s what I’ve heard too — it’s still on today. I’m just catching up on the details, so if you know anything else, I’d love to hear it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll confirm 10 with everyone and bring the tool list by soon. Thanks, Eli!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Jules — 10 works for me, and I’ll keep the route simple and the timing tight. Send the tool list when you can, and I’ll note everything down clearly.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks Eli — I’ll get the tool list to you soon and keep everyone posted. Appreciate you making the route simple.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Bo—send over the list and I’ll set the tools aside.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do, Gus — I’ll send the repair drive list over soon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Bo—just send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll keep the tools set aside.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’s great to hear—do you need me to help sort or carry anything?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Dane — that would be really helpful. I’m free after the school run, so just let me know what time the repair drive is set for.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I can help after the school run, too. Just send me the time and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No worries — we can still make use of whatever you’ve got when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — I’ll check the repair list and see what’s needed before I assign anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Hana — that would help a lot. I’m here if you want me to keep track of anything.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good to me—please send the route and timing, and I’ll confirm once I can see the schedule clearly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing — I’ll send over the route and timing, and I’ll also do one last check on any supplies we’re still short on.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — that works for me. Once I can see the route, timing, and any supply gaps, I’ll be able to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Mara — I’ll let everyone know Noah’s checking what still needs doing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — once Noah’s list is in, I’ll match it with the tools and supplies we already have.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll tell the group Mara’s ready to match Noah’s list with our tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, Bo — I’m still trying to remember the exact update, but I can go check and bring back what I find. Thanks for being patient with me.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Oren — just send over the key bits when you’ve got them, and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll go pull together the key bits and send them over soon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re all set here by the community center, and I’m keeping track of the drop-off area. If you’re coming, just head to the table near the front entrance.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal — I’ll head to the table near the front entrance.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll keep an eye out for you near the front entrance.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 10 still works for me — I should be free after the morning school run. Go ahead and confirm it with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll confirm 10 with everyone and get the word out right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. Let me know if anything changes, and I’ll keep my pickup window flexible.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’m on it — send me the repair drive details and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair drive details your way and keep everyone posted. Thanks for helping out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks — I’ll look out for the details and check what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep asking around while I’m out, and if I hear anything useful I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that. If you spot anything, just let me know and I can help with the next step.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading out now, so I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ve got a basic toolbox, a drill, and a ladder, and I’m free this afternoon after 3.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, that covers the drill and ladder — thanks, Sam. I’ll bring the spare tape and the Phillips and flathead screwdrivers, and I’ll see if we still need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks Cleo — just let me know the next step, and I’ll be there after 3.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking in — still no changes to the repair drive today, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, still on for today — I haven’t heard any changes. I’ll let you know right away if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming — I’ll plan on it unless you hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ve still got a couple gaps to fill, and I’ll keep you posted as the list gets sorted.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Rosa—just bring the list by when you’re ready, and I’ll set aside the tools we’ll need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Gus — I’ll bring the list by once it’s finalized, and I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Jules — do you have the repair drive parts list yet, or should I keep checking back?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mina — I’m putting the list together now and should have it ready soon. If you check back later today, I’ll likely have it for you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Jules — I’ll check back later today.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’d be great — I’m still piecing together the latest, so any update you’ve heard would really help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the exact repair list, so I don’t want to guess; I’ll confirm what’s needed and let you know as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Hana — that’d really help. I’m mostly just trying to keep up, so I appreciate you checking and letting me know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll send the route and timing in one clear note, with no extra stops. Once you’ve seen it, you can confirm if it works for you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli—that works for me. Send the note over, and I’ll confirm once I’ve checked the timing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Pia — I’ll send the route and timing shortly so you can take a look and confirm.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ve got the sign-up sheet and I’ll help organize the repair list and tools. Uli, if you can, start with the bikes and we’ll tackle the fence panels next.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do the bikes first and bring over what I manage. I’ll keep working through the rest as I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Uli — thanks for jumping in. Bring the bikes over when you can, and I’ll keep the sheet and tools ready for the next round.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
